description:
Battistics Remote is the iPhone companion to Battistics, the free Mac app. It needs a Mac running Battistics, signed in to iCloud with the same Apple Account.

See your Macs at a glance: charge, time left, power, battery health, temperature and whether the lid is closed. Check connected accessory batteries and the apps using the most energy. Start Keep Awake for a set time or until you turn it off, add time, or stop it.

- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, including one for every Mac
- A Lock Screen and Dynamic Island countdown with Add Time and Stop
- A Control Center and Action Button control
- Siri and Shortcuts actions that can name the Mac they act on
- Alerts when a session ends, the battery runs low, the Mac runs hot or it charges to a level you pick

Your private iCloud brings your devices together. Updated versions of both apps also connect over nearby Bluetooth or reachable local Wi-Fi/Ethernet, with automatic command fallback when a path fails. Allow Bluetooth and Local Network on both devices. Nothing reaches the developer; there is no extra account or pairing code. Background and Live Activity updates remain subject to iOS delivery limits.

To look around before you set up a Mac, tap Try a Sample Mac on the first screen.
promotionalText: Your Mac, within reach. Check its battery and control Keep Awake through private iCloud, with nearby Bluetooth and local-network connections.
whatsNew:
Your Mac, within reach.

- Connect nearby over encrypted Bluetooth or local Wi-Fi/Ethernet, alongside private iCloud.
- Keep commands moving through another available connection when one drops.
- See Bluetooth and Local Network permission status, with guidance when access is denied.
- Improved last-update readings and Live Activity recovery.

Update Battistics on your Mac to 1.6.0 or later to use nearby connections. Background and Live Activity updates depend on iOS and available connections.
